response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diffs AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM counts) AS diff FROM counts), region_avg AS (SELECT *, AVG(diff) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff, diff - region_avg_diff AS diff_above_region_avg FROM region_avg WHERE diff > region_avg_diff ORDER BY diff_above_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10
